title: Fabric-Bedrock-Miner
description: Client mod to help you break bedrock (and other blocks like obsidian)
body:
# Depends on

- Fabric API https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api
- malilib https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib
- Fabric Language Kotlin https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin
- (Optional) Mod Menu https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu

# Usage

Have the following items ready:

1. Efficiency V diamond (or netherite) pickaxe
2. Haste II beacon
3. Pistons
4. Redstone torches
5. Slime blocks

Toggle Enable/Disable this mod with default shotcut `LEFT_ALT+B+M` (can be configured)

Open Config menu with default shotcut `LEFT_ALT+B+C` (can be configured), you can config hotkeys, client allowList/blockList here

While the mod is enabled, left click bedrock to "mine" it.

If my mod saves you tons of time, please considering [leave me a star on Github](https://github.com/LXYan2333/Fabric-Bedrock-Miner).
